findings.claim: Immediate selection evidence and descendant credit disagree in direction: the compressed-choice excess fixed-frame RMS is positive (whole-window mean ~0.081 A, CI95 ~[0.070,0.092]) while the chosen-teacher score correlation is only weakly positive (~0.10 compressed, ~0.064 full), so the selection advantage is a small geometric excess that does not translate into a strong affinity-credit signal.

The later-label calculation is terminal-credit mining (schema terminal-credit-mining-1.0) with terminal score time 0.99 and state time 1.0 per batch, and it is explicitly not a terminal affinity effect; multiple testing is BH over 400 survival field/measure tests.

Ancestral coverage is thin: 349 of 700 batch nodes have fewer than 3 ancestors and 531 have fewer than 6, with only 14 complete-survival batches and at most 2 teachers per batch, so survivor bias and sparse ancestry limit any last-record credit interpretation.

Curve-fidelity audit shows the selected 24 contrast curves are not cleanly fit: relative node RMSE ranges roughly 0.39-0.93 (all above the 0.35 rule), and several landmarks (e.g. landmark_16_occupancy5, landmark_15_occupancy5/softmin) carry 10-15 strong sign-conflict nodes, so sign changes and fit infidelity are widespread rather than isolated.

Last-empirical-z and last-fit-z frequently disagree in sign across the audited curves (e.g. landmark_00_occupancy3, landmark_02_occupancy5, landmark_06_occupancy5), indicating the fitted contrast direction is not reliably reproduced at the last observed node.

hypotheses.falsifier: time-conditioned rule does not reduce relative node RMSE below the constant rule or increases strong sign-conflict nodes
hypotheses.observable: relative node RMSE and strong_sign_conflict_nodes of the selected contrast curves under observed-node interpolation
hypotheses.scope: observed score window [0.0,0.5] only; no extrapolation
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned contrast rule (validated observed-node interpolation of the registered temporal_region/temporal_teacher contrast) would track the observed sign changes better than a constant rule, because the audited curves show sign flips and rate changes across the observed window.

hypotheses.falsifier: decoded terminal affinity labels show the excess RMS tracks final affinity benefit
hypotheses.statement: The positive compressed-choice excess RMS reflects a within-path geometric selection advantage rather than a final affinity benefit, because terminal affinity labels are unavailable and the chosen-teacher score correlation is weak.

limitations: No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied, so last-record credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit; the immediate-selection versus descendant-quality comparison is unavailable.
Turnover/increment accounting and joint-diagnostic tables were not read in this budget; within-path change versus cohort-composition claims remain unsupported.
Curve fidelity audit is a container summary read via read_field; per-node empirical arrays were not retrieved, so no absolute reward target is asserted.
All contrast curves are coordinate rewards, not trajectory velocity forces or physical interaction energies.

task.formula: R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau), q=detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance; rho_delta=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1). Actual pointcloud_delta_A defaults to 1 A. Native endpoint VJP, no affinity-head derivative, no extra model forward. teacher_neighbors is a count; temporal_recipe changes only a registered scalar/attention, not velocity. No temperature edits. Inert legacy metadata is not a reward term.

formula_registry.diagnostic_limit: Moment effects, pair kernels and turnover are diagnostic evidence. Executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; legacy robust_delta is inert.
formula_registry.dose: Endpoint-VJP force normalized and RMS-scaled against native predictive update; eta/ramp only in U lane.
formula_registry.prior: Detached nearest-k teachers; log_pi=-q_anchor/prior_temperature; scores beta=0; k is a count.
formula_registry.regional: Detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention; positive surrounding weight.
formula_registry.temporal_region: Same static teachers; validated absolute contrast changes regional attention at observed score nodes.
formula_registry.temporal_teacher: (1-blend)*R_static + blend*R_observed_teacher(time); same shared FLOWR endpoint, no velocity target.

incumbent.topology_policy: Free native graph transitions; no pair-distance acceptance or graph equality veto

task.objective: Final predicted target affinity primary; validity and strain secondary; coordinate control only
task.task_wording: Use these observations to provide your response to the supplied molecular coordinate task.
